Those newborn days? They’re magical, messy, and honestly kind of a blur. Between feedings, diaper changes, and figuring out this whole parenthood thing, one of the biggest questions is where your baby should sleep.

Do you go with a cozy bassinet right next to your bed? Or invest in a convertible crib that’ll grow with them through every milestone?

If you’re stuck in the bassinet vs crib debate, you’re not alone. Every family’s needs are a little different, and the “right” answer depends on your space, your lifestyle, and how long you want that first bed to last.

Let’s break down your options, what to think about before buying, and which dadada convertible cribs are ready to grow with your little one from day one.

What’s the Difference: Bassinet vs. Crib

A bassinet is a smaller, lightweight sleep space made just for newborns. It’s often placed beside your bed for easy nighttime access and feeding. Bassinets typically work up to about 3 to 6 months, or until your baby starts rolling over.

A convertible crib, like the ones from dadada Baby, is a full-size crib designed to grow with your child. Many of our models convert into toddler beds, daybeds, and even full-size beds. They’re built for the long haul and offer years of use in one beautifully crafted piece.

When a Bassinet Might Make Sense

Some families love starting with a bassinet. It can be incredibly convenient during those first few months.

Benefits of a Bassinet:

  • Perfect for small bedrooms or shared sleeping spaces
  • Lightweight and easy to move around the house
  • Ideal for keeping the baby within arm’s reach

Things to consider:

  • Short usage window, usually just a few months
  • Not as sturdy or long-term as a crib
  • You’ll need to transition to a crib fairly quickly

If your plan is to keep bathing close at night or you’re working with a tight space, a bassinet could be a good temporary solution.

Why Many Parents Start with a Convertible Crib

A convertible crib gives you an all-in-one solution from day one. It’s a secure, spacious, and stylish option for babies to sleep in from birth all the way through toddlerhood and beyond.

Benefits of a Convertible Crib:

  • One-time purchase that adapts as your child grow
  • Sturdy, safe, and built with non-toxic materials
  • More room for bathing to stretch, and moving
  • Often more cost-effective over time

dadada’s cribs are thoughtfully designed with your baby’s safety and your home’s aesthetic in mind. They're made from renewable wood and finished with baby-safe, low-VOC paint.

Top Convertible Cribs from dadada Baby

Whether you’re skipping the bassinet or planning a smooth transition, these cribs are built to support your family through every stage.

Austin 3-in-1 Convertible Crib
Simple, sturdy, and timeless. Austin is our most popular pick and for good reason. It transitions from crib to toddler bed to daybed and is GREENGUARD Gold certified for safer indoor air. Its clean lines and solid beechwood build make it a beautiful anchor for any nursery.

Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Crib
If you’re short on space, Soho brings modern design in a compact footprint. It’s ideal for apartment living or smaller nurseries. Like all dadada cribs, it’s crafted with eco-friendly finishes and grows with your child.

Spirit 8-in-1 Convertible Crib
Looking for versatility? Spirit does it all. This stunning crib transforms into eight different configurations, including a toddler bed and a full-size bed. It’s a smart, sustainable choice that’s as flexible as it is stylish.

Not Sure What Size You Need?

Still figuring out what fits your space? You might also want to explore the difference between a full-size crib and a smaller option like a mini crib.

We’ve got a full guide on that too. Check out Mini Crib vs Crib to see which one fits your lifestyle best.

Final Thoughts on Newborn Sleeping Options

Choosing between a crib and a bassinet doesn’t have to feel overwhelming. Here’s a quick breakdown:

  • Want baby close for the first few months? A bassinet or mini crib is a great short term solution.
  • Planning for the toddler years? Start with a convertible crib you’ll love for years.
  • Want a mix of both? Use a bassinet early on, then move baby into a convertible crib like the Austin when they’re ready.

Whatever you choose, make sure it’s safe, non-toxic, and made with your family’s future in mind. At dadada Baby, we design cribs to support your little one’s sweetest dreams—today, tomorrow, and all the days after.
